title: Starting a Queensland tenancy
description: The paperwork for a new general tenancy (house, unit or townhouse) in Queensland, from choosing a tenant to lodging the bond. Summarised from RTA and Department of Housing and Public Works pages.

sources.title: Applying for a rental property – property managers and owners
Rental law changes
sources.organisation: Department of Housing and Public Works (Queensland)

items.title: Advertise a fixed rent and don't seek or accept offers above it
Take applications on the approved form (Form 22) and ask for no more than two documents per category
Offer at least two ways to apply, one of them free and not through a third-party platform
Securely destroy unsuccessful applicants' information within three months of the tenancy starting
Prepare the General tenancy agreement (Form 18a) and give it to the tenant before they sign, with any body corporate by-laws
Name yourself or a nominated repairer for emergency repairs in the agreement
Offer at least two ways to pay rent
Record the date of the last rent increase in the agreement
Give the tenant a copy of the signed agreement within 14 days
Complete and sign the Entry condition report (Form 1a), with photos, and give it to the tenant at the start
Send the tenant a signed copy of the completed report within 14 days of getting it back
Take a bond of no more than 4 weeks' rent and give a receipt
Lodge the bond with the RTA within 10 days
Give the tenant keys for every lock and make sure the home is reasonably secure
